digest.component_or_area: authorship fixture / batched ticket map resolver
propositions: The raw batched map resolver returned empty on first CI attempt but succeeded immediately on replay against the unchanged repository, indicating a transient Git-read boundary rather than a stable parser defect.

The test fixture equivalence assertion incorrectly required one-shot success from build_ticket_position_commit_map despite its documented fail-closed contract on Git transients, while production callers use per-event fallback.
Runtime fault injection at subprocess boundaries (rc128/empty, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError/EAGAIN) each reproduced the organic empty-then-successful-replay sequence on the real temporary repository.
Deleting the previously implicated loose blob left both broad and narrow Git history reads healthy, refuting the earlier ENOENT mechanism as the cause of this recurrence.

A fixture-only bounded recovery helper wrapping at most five exact resolver attempts returns on first complete map and raises persistent diagnostics (fsck, count-objects) on failure, leaving src/rebar production behavior unchanged.
